entities.summary: Marko Haavisto (b. 1970-03-22, Lapinjärvi) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Lapinjärvi and Finland. Known in the fields of finland, composers & musicians, europe.
